verdict.rationale: Pulley is a cap-table SaaS, so programmatic agent access to equity data is a fair axis. The pack shows no API, SDK, or MCP server: the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every candidate path, and the llms.txt only indexes help-center docs, not cap-table data. The only export is a manual Excel download from the UI, and nothing shows reconciliation against a data room, so programmatic agent access is unevidenced.
